admission.justification: Ceiling, crossing-cut, sibling-admission and one-function cases pin the bound; without the record a burst could pass the ceiling.

applicability: Every append to the workspace river, one writer or many, dashboard running or stopped.
conditions: Admission under the river lock; size plus row bytes over the ceiling cuts oldest rows to trim first.
exclusions: Rows that fit no cut even after removal, which are refused and counted.
The dashboard age compaction, which keeps its own hour and interval.

evidence: cases test_every_append_lands_at_or_under_the_ceiling, test_one_function_serves_the_age_cut_and_the_size_cut, test_a_row_that_does_not_fit_after_removal_is_not_written, test_failed_removal_counts_and_leaves_the_file_ungrown, test_bound_values_are_the_packets in mcp/tests/test_tool_event_river.py; pytest mcp/tests/test_tool_event_river.py -p no:cacheprovider -n 0 -q -> 16 passed; notes/reports/role-launch/260928-MIK-L114-worker-4b5eb1b1-ea79-4dac-b8dd-ef796451e0b6.md

statement: Rule-5 bound: 16 MiB ceiling, 8 MiB trim level, one age/size cut function, per-append admission under the river lock.
